summary: Gifford Pinchot NF summit in Skamania County, WA. A 1932 L-6 cab is disputed by 1934 photos; the 2020 Big Hollow Fire burned the peak; no standing cab is described.

facts.design: L-6 cab on a small foundation of built-up rocks
facts.status_note: Cab removed at an unknown date; the 2020 Big Hollow Fire burned the summit, and no source describes a cab still standing
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Gifford Pinchot National Forest

access.note: Reached on foot. Forest Road 5701 is closed to the public beyond the Siouxon Trailhead, and hikers travel at their own risk in the burned areas.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and WillhiteWeb's inventory both give 1932, but WillhiteWeb's July 6, 1934 panoramas show no structure on the summit. The story keeps 1932 as the inventory date and does not settle the build year.

notes_for_editor: Build date is disputed: register and inventory say 1932, WillhiteWeb's 1934 panoramas show no structure. Record material 'wood' (from design) is not supported by any source read, so it is left unverified. Register gives 1.5 miles to Siouxon Peak; WillhiteWeb gives a 2-mile hike, not reconciled. The Forest Service Huffman Peak trail listing and an oregonhikers page appeared only in search snippets and are not cited. The 2021 photos are captions only, not images we can credit.
